description.narrative: The proposed action intends to enhance the EU-Indonesia partnership, by reinforcing policy dialogue and alignment between EU-Indonesia interests, principles, policies and values, while increasing the understanding and visibility of the EU and its role in Indonesia, the region and the world. Building on the first phase of the EU-Indonesia Cooperation Facility, the action will cover several policy areas including governance, human rights and gender equality; trade, investments and connectivity; as well as climate change, energy and the environment. It will be aligned with the EU-Indonesia Partnership and Cooperation Agreement (PCA) in force since 2014 and which serves as framework for bilateral cooperation. It will be guided by key EU and Indonesia plans and strategies, including the Global Gateway and Indonesia¿s Medium-term National Development Plans, as well as the multilateral framework including the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.The action will combine a wide range of tools and initiatives to advance EU strategic interests and priorities in Indonesia, supporting dialogue but also mobilising technical expertise, facilitating partnerships, and reinforcing the EU¿s strategic communication and public diplomacy. It will be planned and delivered in a flexible manner and with a Team Europe approach. It will be closely coordinated with the Government of Indonesia but will also support engagement with the private sector, civil society and the youths. It will play a central role in the EU¿s portfolio in Indonesia, complementing other EU actions outside the bilateral MIP, contributing to the identification and roll out of Global Gateway flagships in the country.
